control.description-key: PBS Hub Studio Master: studio list, studio detail, location and geofence, utilization, live usage, GMV.

data-set.name: studios
data-set.description-key: Bind to the Studio - PBS Hub list. Columns: Title, NamaStudio, KapasitasHost, LokasiStudio, LocationID (lookup to Studio Location), Status.

data-set.name: locations
data-set.description-key: Bind to the Studio Location - PBS list. Columns: Title, LocationID, Latitude, Longitude, RadiusMeter, IsActive. One location can serve many studios.

data-set.name: schedules
data-set.description-key: Bind to the Schedule - PBS Hub list, filtered to the previous and the selected month. Columns: Title, Date, BrandID, StudioID, HostID, StartTime, EndTime, JamLive, Status, Platform, Account, Shift, CampaignName.

data-set.name: brands
data-set.description-key: Optional. Bind to the Brand - PBS Hub list to show brand names. Columns: Title, NamaBrand.

data-set.name: hosts
data-set.description-key: Optional. Bind to the Host - PBS Hub list to show host names. Columns: Title, NamaHost, HostName.

data-set.name: reports
data-set.description-key: Optional. Bind to the Report - PBS Hub list for the same period as schedules, to show GMV per studio. Columns: Title, ScheduleID, LiveDate, Penjualan, ApprovalStatus, Match, BrandID.

property.name: StudiosJson
property.description-key: Optional JSON fallback for the studios dataset: JSON(ShowColumns(Studio - PBS Hub, ...)).

property.name: LocationsJson
property.description-key: Optional JSON fallback for the locations dataset.

property.name: SchedulesJson
property.description-key: Optional JSON fallback for the schedules dataset.

property.name: BrandsJson
property.description-key: Optional JSON fallback for the brands dataset.

property.name: HostsJson
property.description-key: Optional JSON fallback for the hosts dataset.

property.name: ReportsJson
property.description-key: Optional JSON fallback for the reports dataset.

property.name: Context
property.description-key: JSON: { userEmail, userName, roles, permissions, config: { maxAccuracyMeters } }. Never carries row data.

property.name: Mode
property.description-key: Admin shows edit actions. ReadOnly hides them.

property.name: ActionResult
property.description-key: JSON reply from canvas: { requestId, status: ok or error, message, data }.

property.name: OperatingHourStart
property.description-key: Studio opening hour (0-23) used as the utilization denominator. Default 8.

property.name: OperatingHourEnd
property.description-key: Studio closing hour (1-24) used as the utilization denominator. Default 22.

property.name: SelectedStudioId
property.description-key: StudioID of the open detail page. Set it to deep-link into a studio; read it to know which one is open. Blank = list.

property.name: ActionPayload
property.description-key: JSON intent emitted by the control: { action, requestId, payload }. Handle it in OnChange.
